cover.title: Venus Hides Under Clouds
cover.subtitle: A bright planet with big surprises

pages.text: Look near sunrise or sunset. A bright dot may shine in the sky. That is Venus, our glowing planet neighbor.
extras: Venus is the second planet from the Sun.

images.alt: A spacecraft view of Venus glowing against dark space.

pages.text: Venus is almost Earth's size. But Venus is not like home. Earth is cool and wet. Venus is hot, hot, hot!

images.alt: A simple NASA cartoon picture of Venus for children.

pages.text: Venus is the hottest planet. Its ground is so hot that lead would melt. No puddles can stay there.
extras: Even Mercury is not as hot.

images.alt: An orange radar globe showing the hidden surface of Venus.

pages.text: Why so hot? Venus wears a thick blanket of air. The blanket traps heat and presses down hard.

images.alt: A gold and brown globe of Venus covered in thick clouds.

pages.text: Clouds cover Venus all around. They hide the ground, like a curtain wrapped around the whole planet.

images.alt: Tan and white cloud bands covering Venus in a wide spacecraft image.

pages.text: Robot spacecraft use radar to peek through the clouds. Peek! Underneath, Venus has rocky land.

images.alt: A radar view of rocky craters and rough ground on Venus.

pages.text: The hidden land has craters, mountains, and many volcano places. Venus is quiet in pictures, but its rocks tell stories.

images.alt: A radar map globe of Venus showing mountains and surface features.

pages.text: A day on Venus is longer than a year on Venus. Venus spins very, very slowly.

images.alt: A smooth gray spacecraft image of Venus during a robot flyby.

pages.text: Venus even spins backward. If we could watch safely, the Sun would rise in the west and set in the east.
extras: Venus has no moons and no rings.

images.alt: A colorful full globe of Venus for a page about its unusual spin.

pages.text: People do not walk on Venus. Robot explorers visit for us. Goodbye, bright Venus, with clouds hiding a hot, rocky world.

images.alt: A wide Mariner 10 image of Venus covered in pale clouds.
